title: Docs drift: README omits the health strip and the 4.2.0 CLI-first change; multi-account-cli.md is silent on token renewal, write-back and live-session rules; README:156 and docs/multi-account-cli.md:115 overclaim tmux propagation
first_slice: Update README and docs/multi-account-cli.md to match 4.3.3 behaviour

title: Auto-switch never re-arms once every profile was capped: it marks the capped profile, logs 'All profiles at 100% or unavailable', and retries only when that same profile drops below 100%, so an opted-in user stays stranded when another account comes back
first_slice: Re-run the auto-switch search on any eligible profile regaining room while the active one is capped

title: Auto-switch and Claude alerts watch only the 5-hour session window: a weekly limit at 100% never triggers a switch and never warns, although weeklyWarning/weeklyCritical alert types and their nine-locale strings exist and nothing sends them
first_slice: Decide whether the session-only policy is deliberate; if not, admit Claude weekly windows to alerts and to the auto-switch trigger

title: Link Account symlinks every top-level entry of ~/.claude except two files, so every linked account shares one projects/ (conversations and auto memory) and sessions/ pool, Team seats included, while the dialog says only settings are shared
first_slice: At minimum disclose it in the link dialog and docs; the deliberate per-account setting is Idea 2 (i-20261025-02)

title: Make Active reports success when the terminal pointer write failed: a thrown switchToAccount is logged 'non-fatal', the profile is still marked active and the button disappears; the auto-switch banner also fires when the request was dropped as 'already in progress'
first_slice: Make activateProfile return an outcome and show failure; the receipt-on-every-switch is Idea 8 (i-20261025-08)

title: The release pipeline never launches the built app: spctl and Gatekeeper checks pass a bundle that cannot start, which is how 3.3.0 shipped unlaunchable; the clean-account launch is a manual step after publishing
first_slice: Add a release gate that launches the notarized, stapled app from the DMG on a clean account and fails unless the process is still alive after N seconds

title: The live-process detector counts Claude Desktop's bundled Claude Code and headless `claude -p` workers as live sessions on the default account (any path containing /claude-code/, no CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR), so renewal can be refused and an account reported 'asleep' when no terminal session exists
first_slice: Exclude the Desktop bundle path and label print-mode runs before treating a match as a live session
